unit: ships a fiscal year, October to September, both directions

rows.report: Informe Anual 2016, in Spanish, text: 'los buques GNL, el Canal de Panama registro 15 transitos'
rows.note: The expanded locks opened on 26 June 2016, three months before the year's end; the 2018 report's chart prints 17 for the same year, and the year's own text is kept.
